localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel blobs distributed along the visible margins and upper surface of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of sessile organisms, including white calcified clusters and trailing brown/yellow filamentous organic matter attached to the distal edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Pendant brown macroalgae hanging from both visible fluke tips, creating a fringed appearance.
